designRule: The player does not choose a branch menu or enter a door. When the Bloom Residue fork is stable, pulse turns inherited residue into a quiet Grave Memory pocket inside the same host tissue.

triggerPrototype.afterReady: Pulse residue memory silt or the warmed seed-choice braid while the Bloom Residue fork is stable.

worldFacingRead.beforeReady: The fork remembers, but the remains are not safe to read yet.
worldFacingRead.nearlyReady: The residue is settling into a lower route. The Guide grows quieter.
worldFacingRead.ready: The old remains are answering. Pulse the residue, not the doorway.
worldFacingRead.trigger: Pulse the stable residue and let the grave bed form without forcing it open.
worldFacingRead.arrival: This is not a loot pile. Read before you consume. Leave what is not ready.

visualLanguage: inheritance seed glow held inside residue
plannedDestinationFeel.movementFeel: slower, quieter, lower pull; the space feels reverent rather than reward-heavy
plannedDestinationFeel.playFunction: first runtime step into the Grave route while deferring the actual read-before-absorb loop
